reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) directly demonstrates the synthesis of HCP RuRhPdPtIr layers on Ru seeds, their thermal stability, and their superior alkaline HER performance relative to FCC counterparts, attributing this to synergistic electronic effects. premises: Heteroepitaxial deposition on HCP Ru seeds can enforce an HCP structure in a RuRhPdPtIr HEA shell despite most constituent metals preferring FCC.
The HCP HEA structure is stable under synthesis and catalytic conditions.
The HCP structure enhances alkaline HER activity compared to an FCC HEA counterpart.
The enhanced activity arises from synergistic electronic interactions that modulate H* and OH* binding energies on Pt and Ir sites.
